answer: Every claim climbs the knoll of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the garden re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the trellis of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
